title: AME: A Multi-Type Contributor Attribution Framework in Generative AI Markets
abstract: arXiv:2606.16075v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI enables value creation through multi-stage collaboration among heterogeneous contributors, including training data, base models, fine-tuning behaviors, and prompts. However, how to fairly allocate the data value remains largely unexplored. This paper formulates multi-stage generative AI value allocation as a new research problem and identifies three core challenges: heterogeneous data contribution valuation, data rights mapping, and trustworthy execution. We propose AME (Attribution-Mapping-Execution) framework, a unified framework that integrates data contribution valuation, data rights mapping, and trustworthy execution into a single workflow. Experimental results demonstrate that AME framework achieves data value allocation outcomes more consistent with human reference judgments while maintaining low-cost trustworthy execution. translated_title: AME：生成式AI市场中的多类型贡献者归因框架
translated_abstract: 生成式AI通过训练数据、基础模型、微调行为和提示词等异构贡献者的多阶段协作实现价值创造。然而，如何公平地分配数据价值在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文将多阶段生成式AI价值分配表述为一个新研究问题，并识别出三个核心挑战：异构数据贡献估值、数据权利映射和可信执行。我们提出了AME（归因-映射-执行）框架，这是一个将数据贡献估值、数据权利映射和可信执行整合到单一工作流中的统一框架。实验结果表明，AME框架在实现与人类参考判断更加一致的数据价值分配结果的同时，保持了低成本的可信执行。我们的工作为生成式AI市场中的价值评估和收入分配提供了初步基础。
tldr: 本文提出AME统一框架，将数据贡献估值、数据权利映射和可信执行整合到单一工作流中，为生成式AI市场中训练数据、基础模型、微调行为和提示词等多类型贡献者的公平价值分配问题提供了首个解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AME, a unified framework that integrates data contribution valuation, data rights mapping, and trustworthy execution into a single workflow, providing the first solution for fair value allocation among multi-type contributors (training data, base models, fine-tuning behaviors, and prompts) in generative AI markets.
